subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Comparar informações sobre um mesmo fato divulgadas em diferentes veículos e mídias, analisando e avaliando a confiabilidade.

components.description_pt: Comparar como diferentes mídias ou formatos apresentam a mesma informação e avaliar sua eficácia relativa
components.description_en: Compare how different media or formats present the same information and assess their relative effectiveness
components.cc_component_description: Compare how different media or formats present the same information and assess their relative effectiveness

components.description_pt: Identificar diferenças em ênfase, enquadramento e detalhes entre fontes de notícia
components.description_en: Identify differences in emphasis, framing, and detail across news sources
components.cc_component_description: Contrast differences in perspective and detail between firsthand and secondhand accounts of the same topic

components.description_pt: Avaliar a confiabilidade de cada fonte de notícia baseado em evidências e critérios
components.description_en: Evaluate the reliability of each news source based on evidence and criteria
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the credibility and accuracy of each source used in a multi-source analysis

components.description_pt: Analisar possíveis vieses ou perspectivas presentes em um relatório de notícia dado
components.description_en: Analyze potential biases or perspectives present in a given news report
components.cc_component_description: Identify the point of view or purpose of an author in a given text

cc_matches.description: Integrate and evaluate multiple sources of information presented in different media or formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively) as well as in words in order to address a question or solve a problem.
Compare and contrast a firsthand and secondhand account of the same event or topic; describe the differences in focus and the information provided.

Integrate multiple sources of information presented in diverse formats and media (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) in order to make informed decisions and solve problems, evaluating the credibility and accuracy of each source and noting any discrepancies among the data.
Assess how point of view or purpose shapes the content and style of a text.
